name: TCL 55C725
summary: TCL 55C725 ships with pushed TCL content, Live FAST channels and analytics. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Italian TCL runs Google TV on Android 11 with 2 GB of memory. It ships with TCL content pushed to the home screen at boot, a TCL Channel browser, TCL Live FAST channels, a store demo sticker, a message box, TCL analytics and partner setup. Extras include a WebView test browser, games, a screen reader and an e-manual.

The list was applied and verified on a real unit over Ethernet, with a reboot. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on. TCL's TV, input and remote apps are kept.

notes: The remote's gear key is remapped when the stock quick settings panel is off. See the app's steps.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 55C725?
faq.a: This list does not turn off the voice assistant. The microphone manager and assistant LED are kept.
Chromecast is kept. TCL's T-Cast phone casting is on the list and is switched off.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Google TV home screen back.
